contribution-rhythm.title: Saving can fit changing work patterns
contribution-rhythm.explanation: Your completed contributions appear in {{months}} different months. Informal-sector income can vary, so a flexible approach may be more practical than a fixed schedule.
contribution-rhythm.nextStep: Choose a contribution rhythm that feels manageable for your circumstances.

contribution-records-unavailable.title: Contribution history is not available right now
contribution-records-unavailable.explanation: Personal contribution details could not be loaded, so these tips use general savings guidance rather than estimates about your account.
contribution-records-unavailable.nextStep: Try refreshing the dashboard when your connection is available.

starting-small.title: Every savings journey starts somewhere
starting-small.explanation: There are no completed contributions in the available history yet. There is no required starting amount; your plan should fit your income and essential needs.
starting-small.nextStep: Explore contribution options when you are ready.

balance-awareness.title: Know what is currently recorded
balance-awareness.explanation: Your pension account currently records a balance of {{amount}}. This is the account balance returned by MicoPesa, not a forecast of future growth.
balance-awareness.nextStep: Compare your balance with your contribution history to understand your current position.

balance-unavailable.title: Your account balance is not available right now
balance-unavailable.explanation: The current balance could not be loaded, so no account-specific balance figure is shown.

retirement-estimate.title: Use your retirement projection as a planning estimate
retirement-estimate.explanation: Your current plan targets {{target}}; its projection estimates {{projected}} at retirement. It is an estimate based on assumptions, not a guaranteed outcome.
retirement-estimate.nextStep: Review your target and planned contributions if your circumstances or goals change.

retirement-goal.title: A retirement goal can help guide your saving
retirement-goal.explanation: A personal projection is available after a retirement plan is created. Any projection is an estimate and should not be treated as a promise.
retirement-goal.nextStep: Explore the retirement plan page when you are ready to set a goal.

income-flexibility.title: Plan around variable income
income-flexibility.explanation: For workers with changing weekly or seasonal income, it can help to first account for essentials and then consider what amount, if any, is comfortable to save.
income-flexibility.nextStep: Revisit your approach as your income changes; pausing or adjusting is a valid choice.

emergency-savings.title: Keep short-term needs in view
emergency-savings.explanation: Retirement saving is one part of financial wellbeing. Planning for near-term essentials and unexpected costs can also matter when deciding what you can set aside.
emergency-savings.nextStep: Consider your immediate needs before making any financial decision.

understand-records.title: Check transaction status, not just an attempt
understand-records.explanation: A contribution attempt is different from a completed contribution. Use the recorded status in your account history when reviewing what has been added.
understand-records.nextStep: If a contribution status looks unresolved, contact support rather than assuming it completed.

personalization-limited.title: Personalization is limited right now
personalization-limited.explanation: Some account information could not be retrieved. The remaining insights are general education and do not infer missing financial details.

why-save-early.title: Why Saving Early Matters
why-save-early.summary: Understand how compounding growth makes small, regular contributions powerful over time.
why-save-early.body: Even small monthly contributions can grow significantly over decades thanks to compound interest. Starting at 25 instead of 35 can more than double your retirement savings for the same monthly amount.

choosing-a-contribution-channel.title: Choosing the Right Contribution Channel
choosing-a-contribution-channel.summary: M-Pesa, bank transfer, or USSD - pick what fits your routine.
choosing-a-contribution-channel.body: MicoPesa supports M-Pesa, bank, and USSD contributions. Choose the channel that's easiest for you to use consistently - consistency matters more than the amount.

understanding-fund-risk-levels.title: Understanding Fund Risk Levels
understanding-fund-risk-levels.summary: LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH risk funds explained.
understanding-fund-risk-levels.body: Lower-risk funds prioritize capital protection with modest growth. Higher-risk funds aim for larger growth but can fluctuate more. Your ideal mix depends on how many years remain until retirement.

when-can-i-withdraw.title: When Can I Withdraw My Savings?
when-can-i-withdraw.summary: What to know before submitting a withdrawal claim.
when-can-i-withdraw.body: Withdrawal claims are reviewed by a Fund Manager before payout. Make sure your account is active and your requested amount does not exceed your current balance to avoid delays.

adminNotifications.providerAccepted: Accepted by provider; final delivery is not confirmed.
adminNotifications.testSmsTitle: Send a test SMS to your number
adminNotifications.testSmsDescription: Preview the fixed test message, then confirm to queue it to the phone number registered on your administrator account. It is never sent automatically.
adminNotifications.testSmsWarning: This will send one real SMS after you confirm. The message does not make or represent a payment.
adminNotifications.testSmsQueued: Test SMS queued. Check its status below or refresh delivery statuses.
adminNotifications.testSmsAccepted: Mobile Sasa accepted the test SMS. Delivery is not yet confirmed.
adminNotifications.testSmsFailed: The test SMS failed. Review the recorded status before trying again.
adminNotifications.testSmsUnknown: The provider outcome is unknown. The test SMS will not be resent automatically.
adminNotifications.testSmsDelivered: Delivery was confirmed by the provider.
adminNotifications.testSmsUnavailable: SMS is currently unavailable. Confirm the Mobile Sasa SMS settings are enabled before trying again.
adminNotifications.testSmsRateLimited: A test SMS was already queued recently. Please wait before requesting another.
adminNotifications.testSmsPending: Queued and waiting for the dispatcher. No provider outcome is recorded yet.
adminNotifications.testSmsAcceptedByMobileSasa: Accepted by Mobile Sasa; final delivery has not been confirmed.
adminNotifications.externalSmsTitle: One-time SMS to an external recipient
adminNotifications.externalSmsDescription: Send one individual SMS using Mobile Sasa. No MicoPesa account is created. This feature is available only after full sending access is approved and enabled.
adminNotifications.externalSmsUnavailable: External-recipient SMS is disabled. Mobile Sasa approval and the required production settings must be in place before it can be used.
adminNotifications.externalSmsAvailabilityError: We could not check whether external-recipient SMS is available.
adminNotifications.externalSmsConsent: I confirm that this recipient agreed to receive this one-time SMS.
adminNotifications.externalSmsConfirmation: Review the complete recipient number and message. Confirm only once; this SMS will not be automatically resent if the provider outcome is unclear.
adminNotifications.externalSmsQueued: SMS is queued for its one-time send.
adminNotifications.externalSmsProcessing: The send is in progress. Do not submit another request.
adminNotifications.externalSmsAccepted: Mobile Sasa accepted the SMS. Delivery is not yet confirmed.
adminNotifications.externalSmsFailed: The provider rejected or failed the SMS. It was not resent.
adminNotifications.externalSmsUnknown: The provider outcome is unknown. The SMS will not be resent automatically.
adminNotifications.externalSmsRateLimited: An external-recipient SMS was sent recently. Wait before sending another.
